metadata.name: lsmem
metadata.displayName: lsmem - List memory devices and attributes
metadata.description: List memory devices and their attributes

installation.note: lsmem is typically available as part of util-linux on most Linux distributions

overview.summary: lsmem lists memory blocks and their attributes (size, state, removable, etc.) from the system's memory topology. It helps inspect how memory is divided and which ranges are online or offline.
when_to_use: See memory block layout and sizes
Check which memory is online/offline or removable

syntax.description: lsmem reads from /sys; no arguments are required. Options control output format.

examples.title: List memory blocks
examples.description: Show memory ranges and their attributes

related_commands.description: Shows CPU topology (often used with lsmem for hardware overview)
